scope_notes: Unweighted SGS-CD only: neither SU-CD nor coordinate-Lipschitz scaled selection/steps is assessed. The max notation in Algorithm 2 is disambiguated as argmax by Section 4.2; both cases have strict unique maxima.

The triangle includes redundant dual coordinates, while the path contains one- and two-neighbor accessible sets; serial events are a permitted finite asynchronous schedule with no overlapping updates.

Uniform active-node sampling is conditioned on the listed activation paths, not distributionally tested. All incident neighbors provide current conjugate gradients; stale communications and latency are outside scope.

The fixed conservative eta=1/8 and nonidentity incidence matrices yield finite exact-rational checks; the 1e-12 tolerances comfortably cover binary64 rounding. No convergence-rate, asynchronous scheduling implementation or generic graph guarantee follows.
